Wizard entry point.question: How should the first-run wizard surface when no .migrated-from-v1 sentinel exists?
What tells the blocking middleware that first-run is complete?
Wizard entry point.answer: Always-written sentinel — both paths write <storage>/.first-run-complete; Import additionally writes .migrated-from-v1

Wizard entry point.question: How should the Quit button behave in this web-only phase?
Wizard entry point.answer: Goodbye screen — renders 'safe to close window', writes no sentinel; Phase 15 swaps in native quit

Wizard entry point.question: How should the developer exercise the wizard manually without risking their real DB?
Wizard entry point.answer: Dev reset command — php artisan diederik:reset-first-run (gated to dev runtime) deletes sentinels; pair with throwaway storage dir
